verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API with Bearer-token auth, but nothing in the evidence describes a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The CLI's "live self-describing contract" and the llms.txt file are adjacent features (a CLI contract and an LLM-oriented docs index), not a machine-readable spec of the API, so they earn no credit here.
